headline: Frontlines Shift as Base Turnover Intensifies
war_summary: Since the last dispatch six hours ago the tempo of strategic‑base exchanges has quickened on several fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the most volatile sector, logging forty‑nine ownership changes in the past day; hourly casualties now run at roughly sixty‑five Colonial and eighty‑seven Warden losses and are accelerating for the Wardens. Nevish Line has surged again, with Colonial losses climbing to six‑hundred‑eighty‑five per hour and Warden losses to six‑hundred‑fourteen, both accelerating, while enlistments rise sharply. Linn Mercy, previously cooling, shows renewed pressure: Colonial casualties at forty‑eight per hour and Warden at one‑fourteen, both accelerating, and enlistments climbing. Marban Hollow sustains a high flip count near thirty in twenty‑four hours, with Warden casualties accelerating to sixteen per hour. Mooring County, quiet in the last edition, has recorded twenty‑two base events in the last day and rising casualty rates for both sides. Kuura Strand, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each continue to see a handful of daily flips and accelerating enlistment, hinting at further exchanges. Meanwhile Callahans Passage and Dead Lands bleed heavily with no base movement, and the majority of rear‑area hexes remain static.
